title: Candidate daily runbook - Samir
content:
Morning runbook - quick capture (not polished)

Date: 2026-03-18
Owner: Samir Patel (recruiting coordinator)
Focus: clear interview pipeline, close candidate touchpoints, finish reschedules before EOD PT

Top 3 priorities for today:
1) Confirm panel for Backend Eng onsite (Tuesday) + send agenda + prep slides request to hiring mgr
2) Follow up with 5 candidates who haven't responded to time proposals (esp. L. Ortega, timezone CET)
3) Clear calendar conflicts for product-design loop and update interview buffer rules (15 -> 20 mins between back-to-back)

Time blocks (rough):
- 08:30-09:00 PT: triage inbox (reschedules, last-minute cancels)
- 09:00-11:30 PT: scheduling block (email + calendar proposals)
- 11:30-12:00 PT: quick sync with Maya (recruiter) - list of priority reqs
- 13:00-14:00 PT: interview coverage (onsite coordinator standby)
- 14:00-16:00 PT: debrief writeups + move candidates through ATS stages
- 16:00-17:00 PT: buffer for odd reschedules, follow-ups, wrap-up notes

Candidates to follow up (priority order):
- Lucia Ortega (SWE-Backend) - CET, preferred afternoons. Sent 3 time options 3/16, no reply. Action: call at 11:00 PT if no reply to new proposal by 10:30. Note: recruiter Maya flagged strong match for infra work.
- Tariq Ahmed (ML infra) - asked to postpone due to travel. Need new availability window 3/23-3/27. Action: propose 3 slots and cc hiring manager Priya.
- Naomi Brooks (PMM) - declined panel time earlier. Offered one alternative 3/19 10:00 PT. Confirm or propose 2 backups.
- Ben Carter (SWE-Frontend) - accepted verbal offer, HR paperwork pending. Check background check vendor link and nudge People Ops partner Jordan.
- Aisha Khan (Data Eng) - interview feedback stuck WIP in Greenhouse (missing interviewer score). Action: pings to panel: R. Gomez, S. Li (Slack/DM).

Reschedule / cancellations to resolve:
- Backend Eng deep-dive with R. Patel cancelled (candidate ill) -> offered 3/24 09:00, hiring manager wants earlier. Escalate if candidate not available by 3/20.
- Design portfolio review (candidate M. Nguyen) double-booked with on-call rotation. Proposed remote-only slot 3/22 13:00 PT.

Interview panel logistics checklist (for onsite & virtual):
- Confirm panelists + backup for each slot (always include 1 PM + 1 Eng)
- Send agenda to panel 48h before slot (short bullets: goals, must-ask, time per section)
- Reserve conference room OR Zoom + recording enabled (ask for consent)
- Add 10-min buffer in calendar (I move to schedule template v3)
- Provide candidate interviewer cheat-sheet (bio + top 3 questions)

Templates / copy to send (quick snippets):
- "Thanks for your patience — are you available: [opt1], [opt2], [opt3] (all in your TZ)?"
- "Quick reminder: your interview is at [time], please join via [zoom link]. If you need to reschedule, reply within 24h."
- Offer next steps note for hiring manager: "Candidate X had strong signals on Y; recommend 2nd round or pass? Please leave feedback on Greenhouse by EOD."

Slack reminders to self:
- #recruiting: post follow-up summary at 11:45 PT (after inbox triage)
- DM Priya about hiring manager availability for 3/24
- DM Jordan about background check hold for Ben Carter

To-do (short actionable list):
- [ ] Send Lucia new time options + call fallback
- [ ] Add buffer rule to scheduling template (change 15 -> 20 mins) and save as template v3
- [ ] Update Greenhouse stages for Aisha Khan (move to "feedback pending")
- [ ] Draft panel agenda for Backend Eng onsite and attach job rubric
- [ ] Confirm lunch catering headcount for onsite 3/24 (if in-person)

Notes to self / reminders: 
- Keep an eye on timezone confusion: always include candidate TZ in subject line.
- When cc'ing hiring manager, include one-sentence context; they ignore long threads.
- If candidate pandas through 2 rounds without score -> escalate to recruiter weekly digest.

Open items / questions (need resolution):
- Should we allow 2 back-to-back interviews for IC candidates? (ops cost vs interviewer fatigue) -> bring to weekly ops sync
- Background check vendor delay for new offers: what SLA? Follow up with People Ops partner Jordan.

End-of-day wrap (what to update before leaving):
- Move all scheduled interviews to "confirmed" in ATS and add interviewer assignments
- Log any partial debrief notes in candidate profile (flag for recruiter)
- Update #recruiting: daily status message with 1 urgent item and 2 wins

Quick reference links (copy paste):
- Scheduling template v3: confluence://recruiting/scheduling-template-v3
- Interviewer cheat-sheet: confluence://recruiting/cheatsheet
- Greenhouse job page: https://app.greenhouse.io/jobs/RE-221

Scratch notes (messy) - ideas for improvements:
- Auto-timezone reminder in calendar invite title (e.g., "Interview — 10:00 PT / 18:00 CET")
- Quick-add Slack shortcut to nudge panel after interview ends (30m auto message)
- Weekly recruiter digest for all feedback pending >48h

End of runbook (will tidy into Confluence later if needed).

Quick signature: Samir P. (recruiting coordinator)
Notes saved: local scratch, NOT final artifact.
